Our Story

Rooted in tradition,
crafted for today

Geisha Asia is a modern, Japanese-inspired restaurant offering an exquisite dining experience. Our pan-Asian menu features delicious sushi, dim sum, and a variety of other mouth-watering dishes.

The unique setting of our restaurant, with its Japanese garden-inspired design, is the perfect place to enjoy a meal with family and friends — whether that's a romantic dinner for two or a fun night out with friends.

A table for every craving, under one roof
Our Story

One kitchen,
every cuisine

Embark on a delightful culinary journey at Geisha Fusion! Our family-friendly restaurant presents a vibrant array of dishes from across the globe.

Our diverse menu blends classic favourites with modern twists, inspired by a variety of international cuisines — whether you're in the mood for an American-style burger, a mouth-watering curry, or crispy aromatic duck, our chefs are ready to serve up the flavours to delight your palate.
